# `federal_register_documents`

**Federal Register typed documents (Layer 1)**

One natively typed row per dated Federal Register record, keyed by (`document_number`, `publication_date`), derived by streaming immutable 31-field federalregister.gov API JSON pages referenced by `federal_register.source_sha256`. Adds native `DATE` and `BIGINT` columns, `full_text_xml_url`, `agency_names`, `source_record_id`, `source_locator`, and `member_names` sparsity tracking alongside the compatibility `federal_register` table.

**Coverage.** Derived: exact 1-to-1 dated-key counterpart of `federal_register` from 1994-01-03 onward, streamed from immutable 31-field API JSON pages in R2 source evidence. *(measured 2026-11-28)*

**Data quality.** Reconciled 1-to-1 on (`document_number`, `publication_date`) and `source_sha256` against the pinned `federal_register` generation; conflicting same-date observations and legacy 22-field or pre-1.3 pages are refused fail-closed. `member_names` records the exact JSON keys present on each raw document object so absent fields remain distinct from explicit JSON `null`, `false`, empty lists (`[]`), and empty objects (`{}`). `agencies` and `cfr_references` store per-element JSON strings in publisher order (including nested URLs stripped from `federal_register`); join `federal_register_agencies`, `federal_register_cfr_references`, and `federal_register_docket_candidates` on (`document_number`, `publication_date`) for typed child rows.

- **Parquet file:** `federal_register_documents.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `source_record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reversible dated source identity (`document_number@YYYY-MM-DD`) minted by SpicyDocs. |
| `document_number` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Federal Register document number as served (`2017-07442`, unpadded before 2013). Part of the composite primary key with `publication_date`. |
| `publication_date` | `DATE` | Native `DATE` the document was published in the Federal Register. Part of the composite primary key with `document_number`. |
| `source_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 digest (`sha256:<hex>`) of the immutable 31-field API JSON page under `source-evidence/blobs/sha256/<hex>` from which this row was parsed. |
| `source_locator` | `VARCHAR` | Zero-based JSON Pointer (`/results/<index>`) locating this document inside the retained API page blob. |
| `abstract` | `VARCHAR` | Agency abstract of the document; NULL when null or absent (check `member_names`). |
| `action` | `VARCHAR` | Document action line as stated by the API (e.g. `Final rule.`, `Final rule; correction.`); distinguishes corrections and delays from initial rules. |
| `agencies` | `VARCHAR[]` | Ordered `VARCHAR[]` of compact JSON strings for each publisher agency object in `agencies`, preserving source order, repeated canonical IDs/slugs, `url`, and `json_url`. |
| `agency_names` | `VARCHAR[]` | Ordered `VARCHAR[]` of publisher agency display names (`agency_names`), preserved verbatim from the 31-field API response. |
| `body_html_url` | `VARCHAR` | URL of the document's full-text HTML body on federalregister.gov; NULL when absent or null. |
| `cfr_references` | `VARCHAR[]` | Ordered `VARCHAR[]` of compact JSON strings for each publisher CFR reference object, preserving `title`, `part`, `chapter`, and `citation_url`. |
| `comments_close_on` | `DATE` | Native `DATE` closing deadline for public comments; NULL when the document states no comment deadline. |
| `correction_of` | `VARCHAR` | API URL of the document corrected by an editorial Federal Register correction record; NULL otherwise. |
| `corrections` | `VARCHAR[]` | Ordered `VARCHAR[]` of API URLs for editorial corrections linked to this document; empty list `[]` distinct from NULL. |
| `disposition_notes` | `VARCHAR` | Literal presidential document disposition notes from schema 1.3; NULL when null or absent. |
| `docket_ids` | `VARCHAR[]` | Ordered `VARCHAR[]` of literal docket labels printed on the document; see `federal_register_docket_candidates` for normalized Regulations.gov candidates and `regulations_dot_gov_info` for publisher-stated docket links. |
| `effective_on` | `DATE` | Native `DATE` stated as `effective_on` by the Federal Register API; NULL when omitted. |
| `end_page` | `BIGINT` | Native `BIGINT` last page number in the Federal Register volume. |
| `executive_order_notes` | `VARCHAR` | Literal executive-order history prose from schema 1.3; preserves source line breaks and spelling. |
| `executive_order_number` | `BIGINT` | Native `BIGINT` executive order number for presidential executive orders; NULL otherwise. |
| `full_text_xml_url` | `VARCHAR` | Official XML full-text URL served by federalregister.gov; carried here and omitted on legacy `federal_register`. |
| `html_url` | `VARCHAR` | Document landing page URL on federalregister.gov. |
| `pdf_url` | `VARCHAR` | Official PDF rendition URL; NULL where the Register serves no PDF (chiefly 1994 records). |
| `president` | `VARCHAR` | Compact JSON text of the publisher's `president` object (`{identifier, name}`) as stated across all document types; NULL when null or absent. |
| `regulation_id_numbers` | `VARCHAR[]` | Ordered `VARCHAR[]` of Regulation Identifier Numbers listed by the API; empty list `[]` distinct from NULL. |
| `regulations_dot_gov_info` | `VARCHAR` | Compact JSON text of the publisher's `regulations_dot_gov_info` object (`{}` when stated empty, distinct from NULL); retains the publisher's stated Regulations.gov `docket_id` separately from normalized `docket_ids`. |
| `significant` | `BOOLEAN` | Native `BOOLEAN` Executive Order 12866 significance flag (`true`, `false`, or NULL when neither is stated). |
| `signing_date` | `DATE` | Native `DATE` a presidential document was signed; NULL for non-presidential documents. |
| `start_page` | `BIGINT` | Native `BIGINT` first page number in the Federal Register volume. |
| `subtype` | `VARCHAR` | Federal Register document subtype when stated (e.g. `Executive Order`); NULL on most non-presidential documents. |
| `title` | `VARCHAR` | Document title as served by the Federal Register API. |
| `topics` | `VARCHAR[]` | Ordered `VARCHAR[]` of Federal Register CFR index topic terms; empty list `[]` distinct from NULL. |
| `type` | `VARCHAR` | Literal Federal Register API `type` field (`Rule`, `Proposed Rule`, `Notice`, `Presidential Document`, etc.). |
| `volume` | `BIGINT` | Native `BIGINT` Federal Register volume number. |
| `member_names` | `VARCHAR[]` | Ordered `VARCHAR[]` of JSON member keys present on the raw source document object, distinguishing absent keys from explicit JSON `null`, `false`, `[]`, and `{}`. |
